paragraphs: Got it, strength training twice a week, bad fitness level right now. If you look out 3 to 6 months, what's the one thing you most want to change or achieve? And any injuries I should know about?

input.userMessage: By end of 2026, i want to be stronger overall. My shoulder was in bad shape a couple months ago, still recovering, and my left knee has issues too. Also, daily habits - I want to read a book for 10 mins and quit smoking and alcohol.

output.reply:
Got it. Getting stronger is the mission, but we have to be smart about that shoulder and knee. We'll prioritize pain-free range of motion and form. I've locked in both injuries so we protect them.

I've set up your season to run through the end of 2026. If we stick to your 2x/week cadence, that's roughly 34 strength sessions between now and New Year's. I've also built your daily habit trackers: 10 minutes of reading, zero smoking, and zero alcohol. Cutting the smoke and booze is going to be massive for your recovery and strength gains.

Ready to put your first week of training on the board? Which two days are we lifting?
